<!-- lemma-1: body_md -->
\@gobble{lemma:HermitePolynomials101}
For each $l \in \mathbb Z_{> 0} $, the following holds;
\begin{description}
\item[a)]  $ He_{l+1} (x) = x He_{l} (x) -  l He_{l-1}(x) , $

\item[b)]  $ He_{l} (x) n (x) = (-1)^{l} \frac{d^{l} n (x)}{d x^{l} } ,  $

\item[c)]  $ \int_{d}^{\infty} He_{l} (x) n (x) dx = He_{l-1} (d) n (d) ,  $

\item[d)]  $ He_{l} (x+a) = \sum\limits_{j=0}^{l} \binom{l}{j} a^{l-j} He_{j} (x) $.
\end{description}
<!-- end lemma-1 -->
<!-- lemma-2: body_md -->
\@gobble{lemma:Canonical101}

The following equations hold:
\begin{description}
\item[a)] $ K \exp \left( -\frac{k-1}{2}h_t - \frac{[ k+1 ]^2}{8} v^2 \tau \right)
\exp \left(\frac{k+1}{2}h_t + \frac{[ k+1 ]^2}{8} v^2 \tau \right)= x_{t} $

\item[b)]  $ K \exp \left( -\frac{k-1}{2}h_t - \frac{[ k+1 ]^2}{8} v^2 \tau \right)
\exp \left(\frac{k-1}{2}h_t + \frac{[ k-1 ]^2}{8} v^2 \tau \right) = K e^{-r \tau}  $

\item[c)] $ x_t n \left( d_1 \right) = K e^{-r \tau} n \left( d_2 \right) $
\end{description}
<!-- end lemma-2 -->
